content:
Hi all, I'm putting together a roadmap for CompPoly to orient the work we'll be doing on it over the coming year(s). My first draft is here, in three initial phases: (1) shoring up some missing pieces of the theory, (2) performance, and (3) API expansion. I would love opinions and feedback on this. This is supposed to be a Roadmap that makes CompPoly the best version it can be for us! See the ROADMAP at the draft PR here:
https://github.com/Verified-zkEVM/CompPoly/pull/16
